pages.text: Our solar system has the Sun and eight planets. It also has moons, asteroids, and comets.
The Sun is a star. It gives Earth light and heat.
Earth is our home planet. The Moon travels around Earth.
Jupiter is the biggest planet. Its clouds form colorful bands and giant storms.
Saturn has beautiful rings. Its rings are made of pieces of ice and rock.
Our trip through space is finished for now. What shall we explore next?
